title: sendReminder builds a 'log dose' notification action
name: sendReminder
description: Adds a NotificationCompat.Action targeting the new LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver (task-012, same package -- no import needed), letting the user log the dose directly from the notification without opening the app. The action's PendingIntent reuses notificationId (== doseLogId) as its request code -- safe because it targets a different component than the existing content-tap PendingIntent, so they don't collide despite sharing a request code (PendingIntent identity includes the target component). Nothing about the existing permission check, content-tap intent, or notify() call changes.
acceptance_criteria: Signature gains profileId: Int, medicationId: Int, defaultDoseAmount: String parameters
A new Intent(context, LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver::class.java) carries EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID (= notificationId), EXTRA_PROFILE_ID, EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID, EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT
A PendingIntent.getBroadcast(context, notificationId, ..., FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or FLAG_IMMUTABLE) wraps that intent
The NotificationCompat.Builder chain gains .addAction(...) with that PendingIntent, labeled with the existing shared R.string.log_dose resource (via context.getString)
The existing permission check, content-tap PendingIntent, and NotificationManagerCompat.notify(...) call are unchanged
exact_code:
fun sendReminder(
        context: Context,
        notificationId: Int,
        title: String,
        text: String,
        profileId: Int,
        medicationId: Int,
        defaultDoseAmount: String,
    ) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU &&
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) !=
                PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            return
        }
        val contentIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            context,
            notificationId,
            Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
        )
        val logDoseIntent = Intent(context, LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver::class.java).apply {
            putExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID, notificationId)
            putExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_PROFILE_ID, profileId)
            putExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_MEDICATION_ID, medicationId)
            putExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DEFAULT_DOSE_AMOUNT, defaultDoseAmount)
        }
        val logDosePendingIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
            context,
            notificationId,
            logDoseIntent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
        )
        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_popup_reminder)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(text)
            .setContentIntent(contentIntent)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .addAction(
                NotificationCompat.Action.Builder(
                    android.R.drawable.ic_menu_add,
                    context.getString(R.string.log_dose),
                    logDosePendingIntent,
                ).build(),
            )
            .build()
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(notificationId, notification)
    }
